General surgery practice marketing

General Surgery Marketing Agency Connecting Surgeons, Procedures, Offices and Consultations

General surgery practices handle a wide range of procedures, from hernia and gallbladder surgery to breast, colorectal and bariatric work, across offices and several hospitals or surgery centers. Patients and referring physicians want to know who performs a procedure, where they operate, what to expect, and how to request a consultation. We connect those pieces on your website and listings, and track consultation requests by procedure.

We are a Houston-based marketing and web team; your surgeons approve all clinical content.

Availability: general surgery is checked by ZIP code. We already work with surgical practices in parts of Greater Houston, so Houston eligibility may be limited.
Request a surgical marketing consultation

Where surgical marketing breaks

Credentials, procedures and locations that never meet on the page

Surgical websites often list procedures in one place, surgeons in another and locations in a third. Patients cannot tell who will operate or where, and referrers default to the surgeon they already know.

Credentials isolated

Board certification and fellowship training sit in bios, not beside the procedures they qualify.

Procedure pages generic

Short, copied descriptions with no recovery, preparation or surgeon information.

Operating locations unclear

Patients do not know which hospital or surgery center the surgeon uses.

Requests untracked

Consultation requests are not tagged by procedure, so demand cannot be measured.

Services

General surgery marketing services

Chosen after review. We do not guarantee rankings, AI mentions or case volume.

Procedure pages

Surgeon-approved pages for priority procedures with preparation, recovery and surgeon links.

Surgeon profiles

Credentials, procedures, offices and operating locations for each surgeon.

General surgeon SEO and listings

Accurate office profiles and pages; consistent directory data.

Referral resources

How to refer, required records and contacts.

Google Ads for selected procedures

Procedure campaigns with policy review and landing pages, where capacity allows.

Surgeon website design and repair

Fast pages and consultation forms with procedure selection.

Read our article on common SEO errors on surgeon websites. See also healthcare SEO.

Process and evidence

How a general surgery engagement runs

We begin with a surgeon-procedure-location map and your priority procedures.

  1. Assess

    Site, listings, ads and tracking; build the map.

  2. Prioritize

    Connect existing pages and fix request tracking.

  3. Fix foundations

    Repairs, forms with procedure selection, office data.

  4. Improve content and campaigns

    Procedure pages, profiles and selective ads.

  5. Measure and refine

    Monthly report by procedure and office.

Illustrative audit excerpt

Typical general surgery findings

Sample format, not a client.

  • Hernia repair page names no surgeon.
  • Operating hospitals not listed anywhere.
  • Consultation form lacks procedure field.
  • Two offices share one listing.

Who does what: we build and report; your team schedules, coordinates surgery and approves clinical content.

Healthcare marketing in Miami

Engagement and pricing

Scope depends on surgeons, procedures, offices and ads. Proposals separate fees, ad spend paid to Google and one-time work; 7 days’ notice. See the cost guide and the healthcare marketing hub.

Questions and consultation

General surgery marketing questions

For general surgeons and practice managers.

What does a general surgery marketing agency include?

Procedure pages, surgeon profiles with credentials and operating locations, referral resources, accurate listings, selective Google Ads and reporting by procedure.

How should surgeon credentials, procedures, offices and consultation requests connect?

Each procedure page names its surgeons and links to their profiles; profiles list credentials, procedures, offices and operating locations; every page ends in a consultation request tagged by procedure.

Should a surgical practice advertise?

For procedures with capacity and clear demand, yes; otherwise referral resources and organic pages often matter more.

What affects cost?

Surgeons, procedures, offices, site repairs and ads. Quoted after review.

Is general surgery marketing available in Houston, Dallas and Miami?

Houston is limited by existing clients; Dallas and Miami are checked by ZIP code.

How should we measure results and choose an agency?

Track consultation requests by procedure and office. Ask agencies how they handle surgeon approval of content.
